set_aside.subject: starting the periodic session-expiry and backup passes
set_aside.text: Only now the surfaces answer ... Start the passes. Every 60 seconds from the start ... At least once a minute ...
set_aside.question: What happens if either periodic pass cannot be started after the listeners have begun serving?
options: Stop the instance and close both listeners
Keep serving and retry starting the failed pass
set_aside.default_guess: Stop the instance and close both listeners.

witness.initial: Configuration, backup probe, store checks and both listener openings have succeeded.
events: module:instance_lifecycle fails to start the owner-session expiry pass or the backup minute look.
outcomes: Registry stops and closes the listeners because a required running capability was not established.
Registry continues serving, with expired-session cleanup or daily backups absent until some unspecified retry or restart.
witness.observer: The owner and host administrator see either a stopped instance or a serving instance whose expiry cleanup or backups do not run.

set_aside.subject: accepted import whose answer is not delivered
set_aside.text: The transaction commits; then capability:owner_sessions.drop_uploaded_files drops every session's upload ... Answer. Each Customer made, its v1 value and its customer_ref ... every later import refused.
set_aside.question: How can the owner recover the accepted import's v1-value-to-customer_ref result when the transaction commits but its one answer is lost, given that all uploads are dropped and every resubmission is refused for good?
options: Provide an operation that reads the accepted import result
Replay the original accepted result when its confirmation is resubmitted
Provide no recovery and require the owner to reconstruct the mapping outside the import flow
set_aside.default_guess: Provide a read-only operation for the accepted import result.

witness.initial: No migration closure exists; the owner has a valid confirmed import that will create a Customer whose v1 value is not retained as a tax id.
events: Registry commits the imported records, minted customer_ref, closure and audit entry.
The connection fails before the answer reaches the owner.
The owner resubmits the same confirmation or reopens the import flow.
outcomes: The owner can retrieve or replay the committed v1-value-to-customer_ref mapping.
The import is only refused as closed and the mapping is no longer available from any offered module capability.
witness.observer: The owner sees whether the minted customer mapping can be recovered after the lost answer.
